H-A.evidence: Input-shift associations are descriptive only; N=7 and no classifier/regression was fit.

H-B.evidence: LOO early-depth winners=6/7; Gold early-depth winners=1/7. This is a descriptive shallow-to-late displacement in a reconstructed N=7 audit.

H-C.evidence: Joint Top1/Top2/Top4 recovery was 0/7 while marginal depth and view coverage were nonzero. Gold is not uniformly more interaction-heavy than LOO, so this is not a universal interaction claim.

H-D.evidence: One Gold cell improves to rank 3 under its frozen best-fold summary while mean ranks it 32, but other Gold cells remain poor under all predefined summaries; aggregation is not the whole failure.

H-E.evidence: Fold-winner instability versus regret is descriptive at N=7.

H-F.evidence: All results use reconstructed trajectories. CLOSE tasks also miss joint Top4, so drift alone is not established as sufficient.

H-G.evidence: At epsilon=1e-3, every output has median pairwise basin Jaccard 0 and zero all-fold intersection; Top4 median overlap is also 0.

H-H.evidence: Frozen fold winners have off-diagonal median rank 21.0; only 1/54 remain Top4 on another fold.

H-I.evidence: Gold Top1 lies in the epsilon=1e-3 majority basin for 0/7 outputs.

overall.reason: No stable shared multi-fold basin or cross-fold winner transfer was observed, and the Gold optimum is absent from every epsilon=1e-3 consensus basin.
